parameters.apprise_url_plus: x://${ customer_secrets.{{ params.ckey_secret }} }/${ customer_secrets.{{ params.csecret_secret }} }/${ customer_secrets.{{ params.akey_secret }} }/${ customer_secrets.{{ params.asecret_secret }} }
parameters.description:
`msg-to-twitter` accepts an HTTP POST carrying the unified `msg` envelope (`title`, `body`, `type`, `format`), attaches the credentials in your stored secrets, and delivers the message to your Twitter destination — so you run no messaging infrastructure of your own.

Delivery goes out through [Apprise](https://github.com/caronc/apprise), the open-source notification library, driven entirely by your own stored credentials at no cost. A paid variant ($0.001 per message) delivers to additional Twitter destinations bound per enrollment.
parameters.summary: Send a notification to your own Twitter destination by posting a simple `msg` request to the UnitySVC gateway.

akey_secret.description: Name of the customer secret holding this enrollment's Twitter akey

asecret_secret.description: Name of the customer secret holding this enrollment's Twitter asecret

ckey_secret.description: Name of the customer secret holding this enrollment's Twitter ckey

csecret_secret.description: Name of the customer secret holding this enrollment's Twitter csecret
